turns.q: Is a damaged item handled differently from a normal return?
turns.replyTail:
tly from a normal return?

Yes, damaged items are handled differently from standard returns. When an item arrives damaged, we make it right at no cost to you — there are no restocking or processing fees, and we cover the return shipping costs.
For standard returns, items must be unused and uninstalled in their original packaging within 30 days, and they are subject to a 20% restocking fee, non-refundable processing fees, and return shipping costs.

Will the replacement ship with priority?
menu
Replacement items ship via standard ground shipping once processed.
If your build timeline requires faster transit, expedited shipping options (such as UPS Overnight) may be available for the replacement if the item is in stock at the shipping location. However, please note that expedited shipping covers transit time only and cannot bypass manufacturer lead times on custom or build-to-order parts.
